$comment: Kind-level defaults for `bun run add-plugin --kind asks`: a HOSTED kind. The plugin points at asks.world's own connector (`/v1/mcp` on the site), which signs the person in with Google through asks.world and holds no key of theirs. One plugin per network, because a connector is one deployment: `asks` is https://asks.world/v1/mcp (real money), `asks-testnet` is https://test.asks.world/v1/mcp (the sandbox, practice money). serverName is {{NAME}}, so both can be installed side by side. Text templates use {{#TESTNET}} for the sandbox's words. Placeholders: {{TITLE}} {{URL}} {{SERVER}} {{DESCRIPTION}} {{NAME}}.
description: {{TITLE}}: post asks that real people answer, get your app or agent tried by verified pros (a pro ask), or find paid work. Sign in once with Google; anything that pays or needs your signature is one tap on asks.world.
